answer: Because the delta count is verified against the spiral text itself, the saffron audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 66 aliases therefore means producing 66 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
